Support for scholarship students
Congratulations on receiving a scholarship from the University of Auckland! We're excited to support  you on your study journey.
Starting uni can feel overwhelming sometimes, but you're not alone. This page gives you the basics on how scholarships work, how to keep your scholarship, and where to get help if you need it.
Scholarship payments
Most scholarships start paying out in Semester One, after the deadline for adding or dropping courses.
Payments will go straight into your nominated bank account.
To keep receiving payments, you'll need to stay enrolled in an eligible programme, and meet any GPA requirements each semester.
Changed your bank account? Update your details in Student Services Online (SSO) before the end of Week 2 of semester.
What can I use my scholarship for?
Scholarship payments are tax-free (as long as you use it for study-related costs). You can spend it on things like:
tuition fees
accommodation and living costs
study books and resources
travel to and from university,
study equipment (like laptops)
Spending scholarship funds on non-study items could put your scholarship at risk, and you may need to pay it back. Check with the Scholarships Office if you're not sure.
If your scholarship covers accommodation fees, the payment goes directly to Accommodation Services.  But remember, if your GPA does not meet the requirements after your first semester, future accommodation payments may be paused, and you'll need to cover the cost yourself.
Will it affect my student allowance?
Scholarships, prizes and awards can sometimes count as income, which may change how much Student Allowance you can get.
For clear advice, check with
StudyLink
.
How to check your payments
You can view your scholarship payments anytime in Student Services Online (SSO):
Log into SSO
Open the
Scholarship & Payments
tile.
Click on the
Payments
tab.
Click on the
Transactions
arrow.
Hit
Generate Report
to download a PDF.
Keeping your scholarship
To keep your scholarship, you'll need to:
Stay enrolled in an
eligible programme
(let the Scholarships Office know if you change).
Contact the Scholarships Office if you are awarded another scholarship – sometimes you can hold more than one.
Request approval if you need to defer (only for serious medical or personal reasons).
Check if your scholarship requires you to stay enrolled after it ends - otherwise, you may have to repay it.
Email:
scholarships@auckland.ac.nz.
GPA requirements
Your GPA is checked each semester to see if you can keep your scholarship.
You can see your GPA on your unofficial transcript available in SSO.
If illness or personal issues affect your exams or tests see
Aegrotat and compassionate consideration
for more information.
Where to get help
Uni life can be challenging, and support is available for your learning, health, personal and community needs.
If anything happens that could affect your scholarship, let the Scholarships Office know as soon as possible.
